Contract:
```markdown ### Pivot Invalidation List - **Module specs requiring refine:** [list with reasons] - **Neighbour specs requiring work (sideways):** [ — было: <…>; стало: <…>; diagram delta: ] - **Tasks requiring reopen:** [- — reason] - **Rules to revisit:** [list] ```
«Module specs requiring refine» stays DOWN the same scope (siblings under this scope's own Module Map). «Neighbour specs requiring work (sideways)» is the other axis — scopes / interfaces outside this one that `STEP_*_SYSTEM_FIT`'s `sdd-orient` walk found needing a change for this pivot to fit the system (`AX_PARALLEL_MECHANISM_REQUIRES_JUSTIFICATION`); each entry names the concrete path, states Was→Now for that neighbour, and points at its own `DELTA_DIAGRAM_FORMAT` composition delta when that neighbour is itself under `refine`/`pivot` for this change — never a bare path with no Was→Now. An empty sideways list needs the explicit reason «нет — sdd-orient не нашёл соседей», not silent omission.

Used in `pivot` mode for each replaced decision. Self-contained: a future reader of the spec at this git ref must understand the rework without external context.
```markdown -DL-N — (почему: ; было → стало: → ; supersedes: ; pre-rework: ; риск: ) ```
This is the same one-line `DECISION_LOG_ENTRY_FORMAT`, not a second grammar. `` may be a legacy `D-N` only when referencing an existing immutable entry; all new ids use `-DL-N`. Omit an inapplicable risk clause; never add Status/Recorded fields.
Paired with Pivot Invalidation List entries that enumerate concrete downstream artifacts (`refine-module` targets, ticket reopens, rule revisits) for `audit` (`AX_STALE_AFTER_PIVOT_VERIFICATION`).

**Mandatory for any module under `refine`/`pivot`** — the diagram twin of the textual Git diff: the changed specification sections list the delta in words, this rung makes the SAME delta a picture, right next to it. Two parts, both scoped to what changed — the unchanged part of the module is NOT redrawn, per `AX_SPEC_MANDATORY_DIAGRAM`'s discipline of one rung per question:
1. **Composition delta** — the `DBC_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH_FORMAT` graph, but only the changed corner of it, with the new node marked `:::new` (mermaid) or a `(добавлено)` suffix (ASCII):
```markdown ```mermaid flowchart LR OrderService -->|depends on| PaymentGatewayPort RefundAdapter:::new -->|implements| PaymentGatewayPort classDef new stroke-dasharray: 4 2 ``` ```
2. **Call chain delta** — the ADDED steps only, from `CALL_CHAIN_FORMAT` (`formats/dbc-contracts.xml`), appended to (never replacing) the existing chain:
```markdown | Step | Participant | Action | Data | |---|---|---|---| | 5 (добавлено) | RefundAdapter | refund(amount) | amount | | 6 (добавлено) | PaymentGatewayPort | refund(amount) | amount | ```
Caption per `DIAGRAM_CAPTION_FORMAT` (`formats/diagram-vocabulary.xml`) naming the requirement IDs the delta closes. Drawn at `STEP_6_FINAL_HIERARCHY` alongside the textual delta, ASCII first in chat per `AX_CHAT_BEFORE_SPEC`. Mandatory for NEW pivot/refine rounds only — a rework that shipped before this rung existed is not retroactively broken by its absence (2026-08-20 visualization-chain decision).
